s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 武艺天赋补掷出错：
s.en: [DND Rimlands] Combat gift catch-up roll error:

s.zh:
（1.66.0）稀有（蓝色）特性，和强力特性分开计数、可以同时拥有；得到一个之后，每次按“额外武艺天赋”的成功率再得一个不同的，直到失败或达到上限。六个属性类（巨力、迅捷、坚韧之体、博闻强识、鹰眼、王者气度：对应属性 +2，上限同样 +2，再加一项附带效果）和七个战技类（连斩、狂暴之血、神射、致命一击、铁壁、再生之体、法力奔涌）。
随冒险者成长：10 级精通（数值 ×1.5，属性 +3），传奇冒险者化境（×2，属性 +4）。
开局殖民者 35%；首领、冠军、传奇怪 50%；殖民者累计击杀 100 / 300 个人形时、完成 DND 里程碑时各有成功率 25% 战斗觉醒（已有的也能再觉醒一个，直到上限）；巨灵“让我更强 · 武艺”。老存档读档时给现有殖民者补一次（35%）。
关闭后不再生成，已有的保留。
s.en:
(1.66.0) Rare (blue) traits, counted separately from power traits and can be held together; after gaining one, each further roll at the "extra combat gift" success chance gives another different one, until a failure or the cap. Six ability gifts (Great Strength, Swiftness, Tough Body, Lore Mastery, Eagle Eye, Kingly Bearing: matching ability +2, cap +2 too, plus a side effect) and seven technique gifts (Chain Strike, Berserker Blood, Sharpshooter, Critical Strike, Iron Wall, Regenerating Body, Mana Surge).
They grow with the adventurer: mastery at level 10 (values ×1.5, ability +3), transcendence as a legendary adventurer (×2, ability +4).
Starting colonists 35%; bosses, champions and legendary monsters 50%; when a colonist's total humanlike kills reach 100 / 300 and when completing a DND milestone, 25% chance each for a combat awakening (those who already have one can awaken another, up to the cap); genie "make me stronger · martial". Loading an old save gives existing colonists one catch-up roll (35%).
When off, no new ones generate; existing ones are kept.

s.zh: 敌人也会拥有武艺天赋
s.en: Enemies can have combat gifts too

s.zh: 关闭后敌对派系的人不再随机带武艺天赋。敌人每个武艺天赋战力 +6%（精通 +9%，化境 +12%），袭击会相应少来一些人。
s.en: When off, hostile faction members no longer randomly carry combat gifts. Each enemy combat gift adds +6% combat power (mastery +9%, transcendent +12%), and raids send correspondingly fewer people.
